blocks.text:
Text is drawn via Pango Layouts. The easiest way to create a
              `Pango::Layout` is to use
              Gtk::Widget::create_pango_layout().
              Once created, the layout can be manipulated in various ways,
              including changing the text, font, etc. Finally, the layout can
              be rendered using the
              Pango::Layout::show_in_cairo_context() method.
blocks.zh: 通过Pango布局绘制文本。创建一个Pango::Layout最简单的方法是使用Gtk::Widget::create_pango_layout()。创建布局以后，可以通过各种方式操纵布局，包括更改文本、字体等。然后可以使用Pango::Layout::show_in_cairo_context()方法渲染布局。
